reviews.x: I bought this for a friend for Christmas knowing its a high quality brand. when I bought it I tested it and it had no fragrance. My girlfriend was at the salon and picked up a bottle and it had a strong earthy fragrance. COUNTERFEIT!!!! DONT BUY

reviews.t: A little goes a long way!
reviews.x: I love this spray! My hair always feels like a million bucks after I spray it on. Leave my hair feeling like I had it professionally done. Super soft and manageable.

I was about to chop all my hair off and go back to my natural brunette because my processed blonde hair was so dry I would wash and condition my hair with everything I could find to help restore softness and life back to it.. the ends were so dry that by the time I turned the shower water off, the ends were already almost completely dry. I wouldn't be able to brush it because it was so tangled and I would have so much breakage... it was the worst. I would use any leave in conditioner and nothing

reviews.t: Not as good as the sample size??
reviews.x: Got this in sample size in ipsy and it was amazing. I swear this is different cause its not doing the wonders it did before for my hair... Still good though :)

I was a little nervous after reading some of the reviews. I had received a sample from Ipsy and loved it. This product is the same as the sample I received. I have no issues with the pump. It makes my hair very soft. I can't argue with the price. I'm glad I bought this

I have super thick and curly hair. I can use this product and straighten my hair without damaging it. Leaves my hair so soft without any goop or oil to it. I can last four days without washing my hair when I use this and straighten it. One of my must have beauty products.
Love this stuff! I have naturally curly, think hair. I use this daily! It doesn’t weight my hair down.
My hair has never been healthier, just ask my stylist. I'm a natural brunette but highlight regularly. I blow dry and straighten nearly daily and this works much better than it's a 10.

reviews.t: My bottle had a cream like conditioner in
reviews.x: This is supposed to be a liquid spray - that’s not what was inside my bottle. My bottle had a cream like conditioner in it

I rec'd a sample of Neuma Moisture Instant Fix and now hope I never have to live without it! Just a couple of sprays is all I need for my short hair. Styles it beautifully - shiny and strong all day. I have an oily scalp and by the end of the day my hair is usually feeling weighed down. Not so with this. Even better, I don't have to use hair spray to have a lovely hold. It's cruelty free and no fake fragrance. Just a lovely, lovely product. I hope they never stop making this. I'm hooked for life

This is by far my favorite hair care product I’ve ever found. Every time I use this product my hair is so so soft I can’t stop running my fingers through it. I’ve been dying my hair (bleach too) since I was 16. I’m 28, and you’d never know my hair has been dyed because of this product. It’s healthy, shiny & smooth every time. I use it after I shower and towel dry my hair. I’ll then let it either air dry, or blow dry it and there’s no damage.  I also LOVE that it’s vegan. Can’t go wrong there.

I like this leave in conditioner.  My hair feels quite a bit less dry/more soft and conditioned.  It seems to improve manageability as well.  Most importantly, I have trouble with many products causing a reaction on my scalp and sometimes even face and neck where my hair has contact.  This conditioner DOES NOT cause any reaction thus far.  This is by far the best leave in conditioner I have used.  Pricey I think, but it actually does what it promises, so well worth the price I'd say.

I really love this leave-in conditioner!  It's got a bit of a thicker texture compared to lots of spray conditioners but it's nice and moisturizing.  The cons for me are ~ the thickness makes it tricky to keep the sprayer working.  I find that I can usually remove and rinse out my sprayer top and/or add just a hint of water to the product to get it flowing again.  The high price tag and sprayer issues are the only things that keep me from giving this a full five stars.

Product as described. Ive tried a lot of leave in conditioners that were also a heat protectant and they've all had an off smell to me. This one on the other does not. It almost smells like shay butter and isn't super strong smelling. Leaves hair soft and less frizzy. Not greasy. And protects against heat too.

reviews.t: Awesome for fine/thin hair. Doesn’t weigh hair down!
reviews.x: One of the best hair products I’ve used! I have very thin hair. Whenever I use heat protectants it leaves a waxy and greasy residue which flattens my hair. This product is the total opposite! I can tell when I forget to spray it on...I have a bad hair day! Totally one of my favorite hair products of all time.

Perfect for a light weight styler for fine hair. I only prefer one styler. It doesnt give me super defined curls, but I prefer the messy look because it means volume. With it being a conditioner, it is super easy to use for after my cardio workout mid week and avoiding washing again for a few days.

I got a sample in my Sept Ipsy bag. It just ran out and I HAVE to have this. I blow dry and straighten my fine, frizzy hair daily and this stuff keeps my hair soft and smooth all day.  It's more like a lightweight cream vs liquid but does not weigh down your hair at all.

I love this product but they put it in an envelope and of course it leaked! Very expensive item to ship in such a careless way. NeuMoisture Instant Fix is wonderful and I’ve had trouble finding it in stores.

reviews.t: It's exactly the way it's supposed to be..........
reviews.x: I received the sample from my Ipsy bag. It is a thick conditioner( not watery) that comes out as a spray. I couldn't find anything else to work in my mixed son's hair and this work wonderfully,I love it!!
Works good. It does leave my tile floor very slippery so be careful of that. Other reviews complained about the sprayer I have had no problem and have used half the bottle so far
it is the only product I now of that removes frizz and protects hair from heat at the same time
Perfect leave in conditioner, heat protectant, detangler! Light weight.

I hope that the pump works, the biggest complaint in reviews-- the quality praised. I will return this product if that pump misfires.  I've spent a lot of money on products like Sebastian hair spray which is really a good product but the spray operator won't work after a few sprays.  So far I like this product because my salon stylist said to get it and not buy it at the salon, too expensive, the price on Amazon, about 1/3 less. So I did order this from Amazon and its not the actual product its supposed to be.. it is def a counterfeit. compared to the real one it doesn't have a great smell to it and it doesn't do the smoothness as the real product.. i must say it does work really well for a counterfeit but nothing compares to the real deal.. i wouldn't buy it from here again, but that doesn't mean its not good.

reviews.t: Great for non hair people like me
reviews.x: I love this stuff. I got it in a sample bag and fell in love. I'm not a good hair stylist (aka I'm horrible at doing my own hair). When I'm out of the shower I put this stuff on as my hair dries it is slick without looking greasy and not frizzy at all. It looks like I did something to my hair when all I did was spray this and brush my hair! I'll forever be ordering this now!

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product leaves hair soft, manageable, and healthy, often noting it works well for dry or processed hair.
Many reviewers with fine, thin, or curly hair say it does not weigh hair down or leave a greasy residue.
Several reviewers praise the scent, describing it as pleasant and not overpowering.
A few reviewers report receiving a counterfeit or incorrect product, including one with no fragrance and one containing a cream-like conditioner instead of a spray.
Some reviewers note the thicker texture can clog the sprayer, and one felt the full-size product performed worse than the sample.
